description: Implementation of the National Minimum Wage of Workers (Amendment) Act, No.11 of 2025
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2025-10-13 (Subject to Confirmation at the next Meeting)
decision_details_body: - The Cabinet of Ministers granted approval to increase the National Minimum Wage of private sector employees in parallel with the increase in the salaries of Public Sector employees, in accordance with a 2025 Budget Proposal. Accordingly, the National Minimum Wage of Workers (Amendment) Act, No.11 of 2025, the Budgetary Relief Allowance of Workers (Amendment) Act, No.09 of 2025 and the Budgetary Relief Allowance of Workers (Amendment) Act, No.10 of 2025 have been passed by Parliament on 20250722, to be effective from 2025-04-01. As per the said provisions, the monthly minimum wage will increase from Rs.17,500/- to Rs.27,000/-, with effect from 20250401, and from 2026-01-01, the monthly minimum wage will increase up to Rs.30,000/-. Such increase in the monthly minimum wage should be applicable to all statutory payments such as Employees' Provident Fund, Employers' Trust Fund, overtime, gratuity, maternity benefits and holiday payments. And every employer, including the immediate employer as well as the principal employer, is legally bound to take steps in accordance with the said regulations in respect of the employees engaged in any industry or service through an intermediary or contractor. The Commissioner General of Labour has been authorized to implement the said provisions and steps have already been taken accordingly to inform the relevant parties on the said provisions through newspaper advertisements. This information was brought to the attention of the Cabinet by the Minister of Labour and it was decided to grant the concurrence of the Cabinet to take the necessary action to ensure that the said provisions are being implemented in the proper manner.
